title: Ezekiel eats bread by weight and drinks water by measure
description: Ezekiel is commanded to make bread from wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt, and to eat twenty shekels a day while drinking one-sixth of a hin of water. The bread is to be baked over human excrement as a sign that the Israelites will eat unclean food in exile, but after Ezekiel's objection the Lord allows him to use cow dung instead. This warns that Jerusalem will lack bread and water and waste away under its guilt.
